embedding.title: Semantic retrieval (embedding)
embedding.description: When off, long-range retrieval uses only the keyword channel (fully local, zero cost). When on, it layers semantic vectors on top — better at finding foreshadowing from hundreds of chapters ago via near-synonyms/semantics, blended with keyword scoring; failures gracefully fall back to keywords without blocking generation. Cloud models send prose to that provider; choosing local Ollama keeps every word on-device.
embedding.buildIndex: Build retrieval index for current project's past chapters
embedding.noProjectHint: Open a project to batch-build its chapter index here.
embedding.indexExplanation: First rebuilds keyword chunks and chapter→volume→book summary trees from chapter text; if embedding is enabled and configured, only chunks missing vectors or affected by a model change are embedded. Without embedding, long-range recall still uses hierarchical summaries + pure keyword search.
embedding.proxyNote: Domestic presets default to a local proxy (bypasses browser CORS when running the tool locally); for deployed builds, change Base URL to the provider's direct endpoint. No GPU? Pick SiliconFlow/Qwen/GLM — cloud compute, just add your key.
embedding.switchToProxy: 🔄 Switch to local proxy (for local runs)
embedding.idempotentNote: Semantic vectors are idempotent and resumable; newly accepted chapters are indexed automatically. Roughly ¥0.2 per million characters in the cloud, free locally.
